verdict.rationale: Greptile's security page states self-hosted customers can turn off logging entirely so chats stay private, giving a path to opt out of usage tracking — but this control is only documented for the self-hosted deployment, and the same page discloses that Greptile may still aggregate/anonymize 'De-Identified Data' for AI training with no stated opt-out for that practice or for the standard hosted SaaS offering. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out toggle for the hosted product, and an opt-out mechanism for the AI-training data use itself.
